title: North East Derbyshire District Council: using Copilot to support better decisions and organisational change
summary: North East Derbyshire uses Copilot for drafting, summaries, and analysis. Reduced repetitive work remains intended; the source does not establish an AI-produced cultural benefit.
account: North East Derbyshire introduced Copilot alongside governance, data, and skills programs to improve decisions and service design. The council describes more evidence-seeking staff discussions and changes in decision practice. It does not isolate Copilot’s contribution from the wider program. Reductions in repetitive work and better resident outcomes remain expected.
purpose: Reduce routine drafting, reporting, and information-handling work so that staff have more time for analysis and service improvement.

ratings.reason: The council expects Copilot to reduce repetitive reporting and information-handling work. No realized AI-produced efficiency or decision-quality improvement is established.
Staff are intended to spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on analysis. The source does not establish that AI produced the reported confidence or critical-questioning gains.

ai_role.statement: The source identifies Copilot drafting, summarization, and analysis uses. Their operational benefits remain expected. It does not establish that AI produced the staff-confidence or evidence-seeking changes observed in the wider training and governance program.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: North East Derbyshire District Council: using Copilot to support better decisions and organisational change

produced_by: The council introduced Copilot and supported staff to explore drafting, summarization, and analysis.
The wider adoption program included data preparation, governance, training, and human review of outputs.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce a benefit from AI are unknown.

headline: North East Derbyshire explores Copilot for routine work
claim_basis: Sources: the deployer's report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
